meta.name: add-ollama-provider
meta.description: Route a NanoClaw agent group to a local Ollama model instead of the Anthropic API. Ollama speaks the Anthropic API natively (v1/messages), so no provider code changes are needed — just env var overrides and a model setting. Use when the user wants to run their agent locally, cut API costs, or experiment with open-weight models. See docs/ollama.md for background.

howto.what: 安装此技能后，Claude 会把指定的 NanoClaw 代理组改为连接本地 Ollama 模型而非 Anthropic API。它会检查并修改两个配置文件，加入环境变量和模型名，然后重新构建并重启服务。
howto.when: 当用户希望代理在本地运行、减少API费用或尝试开源权重模型时触发。需要 Ollama 已安装并运行、模型已拉取、代理组已存在。

say.text: 把示例代理组改用本地模型，然后重启服务验证。
say.note: Claude 会执行构建和重启。

howto.what_en: After this skill is installed, Claude will route the specified NanoClaw agent group to a local Ollama model instead of the Anthropic API. It edits two config files, adds env vars and a model name, rebuilds, and restarts the service.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to run agents locally, cut API costs, or try open-weight models. Requires Ollama installed and running, a pulled model, and an existing agent group.

say_en.text: Point my demo agent group to the local Ollama qwen3-coder model.
say_en.note: Claude will confirm details and edit configs.

say_en.text: Set my agent to use local Ollama and block the Anthropic API to avoid costs.
say_en.note: You'll pick the group and model.

say_en.text: Switch the sample group to a local model, then rebuild and restart.
say_en.note: Claude will build and restart the service.
